Message from a parent
---------------------

My daughter is 14. Autism diagnosis at 6, moderate learning disability, and she started
having seizures at about 9 which are mostly controlled now.

She had some kind of genetic test done through the neurology team — it was a panel, I
think for epilepsy. I do not have the letter any more and I could not tell you the year
for certain. It was before we moved, so somewhere around 2016, maybe 2017. Nothing was
found.

Nobody has suggested anything since. A friend whose son has a similar picture said her
family were offered "the whole genome" recently, which I had never heard of.

Should I be going back to ask about something? And what do I actually say — I am not
going to be able to quote anything technical at them.
